verdict.rationale: Rippling's marketing documents that timesheets can be reviewed inside each pay run with approved hours flowing in automatically. Admins can add bonuses and custom pay types, compare the current pay run against previous ones before final approval, and approve the run with role-gated access up to hitting "Run". Together these describe an in-product review → check → submit flow. Missing for 10: an explicit pre-submit totals preview (only run-to-run comparison is described), in-depth first-party documentation of the step-by-step pay run flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
